nina.c: Heads-up—customers on eu-west1 are seeing increased latency and some 503s for text-generation routes. Root cause looks like ~12% of requests were routed to the xlarge model variant by mistake (policy drift) starting ~09:42 UTC. Impact: p95 latency from ~220ms -> ~1.8s and cost per request jumped. Opening incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3259876543

sre-mateo: Investigating. Early traces show routing layer applied an outdated policy set that prefers larger model for short inputs due to mis-evaluated perf score. Also seeing a few OOMs on smaller infer nodes because of unexpected load reshuffle.

leo.p: Rolling back routing policy to last-known-good (2026-11-14) for eu-west1. Canary 10% now. If rollback clean, will scale to 100% and pin until root cause fixed.

deploy-bot: rollback started: routing-config/eu-west1/policy=20261114 canary=10% (tg: routing-rolling)

sre-mateo: Canary telemetry: p95 back to ~240ms on canary. Error rate on canary nodes normal. Proceeding to 50% in 6m.

ops-tilly: Notifying CS + SRE-runbooks: affected orgs flagged for proactive outreach. Posting initial status to customers.

status-page-bot: Public status posted: "Identified Routing misconfiguration in eu-west1 causing higher-latency model selection for some requests. Rollback and mitigations in progress. More updates shortly." (link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3259876543)

sre-mateo: 50% -> 100% rollout complete at 3259876578. p95 returned to baseline across region. OOMs subsided. Keeping pinned policy for now.

leo.p: Short-term mitigation done. Next steps: 1) rollback policy audit and fix pipeline gating, 2) add automated canary perf check that rejects policy changes increasing cost or latency >10%, 3) postmortem and customer comms.

alex.exec: Thanks team. Please include estimated customer cost exposure in the postmortem and any customers we should proactively credit. Keep execs looped.

sre-mateo: Will file postmortem w/ timeline + RCA within 48h. Owner list: eng-routing (leo.p), eng-runtime (sre-mateo), customer-success (ops-tilly).

nina.c: Public update planned in 1h after monitoring window. If you see any regressions, page oncall. :thumbsup:
